name: Digital Network S.A.
summary: Digital Network SA, together with its subsidiaries, engages in media and advertising business in Poland and internationally. The company provides digital outdoor advertising services; and consulting services. It also provides digital content created by naEkranie.pl website. In addition, the company engages in the distribution, support, and marketing of thematic TV channels, as well as marketing and promotional activities for customers. Digital Network SA was formerly known as 4fun Media S.A. and changed its name to Digital Network SA in April 2022. The company was incorporated in 2005 and is based in Warsaw, Poland. Digital Network SA operates as a subsidiary of Epicom Ltd.
